source_excerpts.text:
Finite contract and construction
--------------------------------
Let a finite undirected network have conductances c_e>0 and terminals A,B.
Use each edge once, oriented in the direction of an admissible potential u:
u_A=0, u_B=1, and Delta_e=u(head)-u(tail)>0 on every active flow edge.
Let j_e>=0 be an exactly conserved unit A-to-B flow, with no incoming flow
at A or outgoing flow at B. Strict increase of u makes its support acyclic.
Zero-potential-drop edges can be ignored only if their flow is zero.

Discrete integration by parts gives sum_e j_e*Delta_e=1. Consequently

  q_e=j_e*Delta_e

is a probability distribution. It has a constructive sampler: draw a directed
flow path using normalized outgoing flows, draw s uniformly in [0,1], and return
the edge of that path whose potential interval contains s. The probability that
the path uses an edge is j_e (prove inductively in topological order using flow
conservation); the conditional probability of selecting that edge is Delta_e.
Thus its marginal is exactly q. Acquiring the graph and outgoing flow tables,
checking conservation and monotonicity, and drawing a path are charged costs.
An explicit graph generally requires O(|E|) input/storage before these checks;
path length is not assumed dimension independent or small.

If every edge with positive Dirichlet energy has q_e>0, define on q's support

  a_e=c_e*Delta_e/j_e,       b_e=j_e/(c_e*Delta_e).

Then a_e*b_e=1 and

  E_q[a]=sum_e c_e*Delta_e^2=E(u),
  E_q[b]=sum_e j_e^2/c_e=R(j).

Classical Dirichlet-Thomson gives

  1/E_q[b] <= cap(A,B) <= E_q[a].

At the harmonic potential h and unit harmonic flow
j_e=c_e*Delta_e h/cap, a is constantly cap and b constantly 1/cap. This
zero-variance ideal supplies neither an efficient acquisition algorithm nor a
certificate of closeness of an approximate pair.

Take two parallel A-to-B edges, c_1=1,c_2=M, u_A=0,u_B=1, and j=(1,0).
The flow and potential are feasible and q=(1,0) is normalized, but E_q[a]=1
while E(u)=cap=1+M. The absent flow edge has positive Dirichlet energy.
Therefore feasibility, monotonicity and normalization do not certify the upper
bound obtained from sampled weights. Absolute continuity of the energy measures
with respect to q, and usable domination/tail bounds, are separate obligations.
In a continuum model the same issue also affects resistance if j is nonzero
where j dot grad(u)=0; both energy measures must be covered.

Sampling and precision
----------------------
If independently certified 0<=a<=A_* and 0<=b<=B_* are available, n iid
samples and Hoeffding plus a union bound give, with probability >=1-delta,

  [1/(mean(b)+B_* sqrt(log(4/delta)/(2n))),
   mean(a)+A_* sqrt(log(4/delta)/(2n))].

Obtaining relative width 1+epsilon still needs a small primal-dual gap and
domination bounds comparable to the respective means. A rare missed channel
can make A_*/E(a) arbitrarily large. A computed flow with conservation error
is not an admissible unit flow until corrected/certified. Exact boundary traces,
outgoing sampling probabilities, weight evaluation and numerical roundoff must
also be accounted for. Unit-flow normalization removes one partition function;
it does not deliver the missing global overlap and tail information.

Stronger existing comparator
-----------------------------
The Berman-Konsowa flow principle already constructs the flow-induced path law
and supplies the lower bound

  cap >= E_path[(sum_{e in path} j_e/c_e)^(-1)].

By Jensen this is at least 1/R(j), so it is at least as strong as the Thomson
lower endpoint here. On a single series path, it gives the exact capacity for
any potential; the cross-flux upper endpoint is exact only for the harmonic
potential. On parallel edges with all j_e>0 the Berman-Konsowa expectation is
sum c_e, although Monte Carlo variance may still be arbitrarily large.
Neither case proves that arbitrary unknown channels are easy to acquire.

strongest relevant path-flow baseline. The remaining worthwhile question is

Let a finite reversible network have endpoints A,B and M intermediate nodes
z_1,...,z_M. Its only edges are A--z_i and z_i--B. Both edges of channel i have
the same positive conductance w_i. Fix gamma>0 and epsilon in (0,1).

An algorithm knows M,gamma,epsilon and the following promise: either all
w_i=gamma/M (null), or one unknown channel J has
w_J=gamma/M+2*epsilon*gamma, with all others unchanged. Its permitted acquisition
operation is a named-channel query i returning w_i, at unit cost. It may choose
queries adaptively and randomly and may stop randomly. Endpoint aggregate rates,
weighted-neighbor samples, and a full graph listing are not supplied.

The required output is an interval [L,U] with L>0 and U/L<=1+epsilon containing
cap(A,B) with probability at least 1-alpha on every promised instance, where
0<alpha<1/2. Then its expected number of queries on the null instance is at least

                     M*(1-2*alpha).                          (1)

Proof of the capacity formula
-----------------------------
With endpoint potentials u_A=0,u_B=1, channel i has energy
w_i*u_i^2+w_i*(1-u_i)^2. This is minimized independently at u_i=1/2, yielding
cap(A,B)=sum_i w_i/2. Thus c_0=gamma/2 on the null and
c_1=(1+2*epsilon)*gamma/2 on every alternative. No admissible relative-width
interval can contain both numbers.

This is a legitimate finite continuous-time reversible Markov chain: choose
uniform stationary probability pi=1/(M+2), set q_xy=c_xy/pi for the edges and
diagonal rates to minus the row sums. The statement is nevertheless about the
declared conductance acquisition oracle, not unrestricted access to this CTMC.

Proof of the query lower bound
-----------------------------
Run the algorithm on the null, retaining its internal randomness. Independently
choose a uniform hidden J, and run the alternative with the same randomness.
Until J is queried the transcripts coincide. If D is the set of distinct queries
made by the null run, coupling failure has probability E_0|D|/M. Therefore the
total variation distance between the null transcript/output and the uniform
mixture of alternative transcripts/outputs is at most E_0|D|/M.
